ImageDescription.value: Shows city walls, streets, villages, forests, temples, pagodas, rivers, and roads. Covers Yanjiao, Xianghe from the east, to Sanjiadian, Liangxiang in the west, from Huairou, Changping, Nankou in the north to Gu'an, Zhuozhou in the south. Relief shown by hachures. Pen-and-ink and watercolor. Japanese in Chinese characters. Title from accompanying index sheet. Sheets individually numbered and titled, e.g.: Pekin kinbō dai 1-gō, Ryū-ke mura = Liu jia tun. Some sheets annotated in pencil or red ink. Includes index map to adjoining sheets. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. ARP Vault
